m.chalisa.cau1: Salutations, salutations to you, Durgā, giver of happiness; salutations, salutations to you, Ambā, remover of sorrow.
m.chalisa.cau2: Your light is formless; its brightness has spread through the three worlds.
m.chalisa.cau3: The moon is on your forehead and your face is vast; your eyes are red and your brows fearsome.
m.chalisa.cau4: The Mother's form is most lovely; seeing it, people find great joy.
m.chalisa.cau5: As Śakti you brought the world to dissolution, and for its sustenance you gave food and wealth.
m.chalisa.cau6: Becoming Annapūrṇā, you sustained the world; you alone are the primal, beautiful maiden, Bālā.
m.chalisa.cau7: At the time of dissolution you destroy all; you are Gaurī, beloved of Śiva.
m.chalisa.cau8: Śiva and the yogīs sing your virtues; Brahmā and Viṣṇu meditate on you always.
m.chalisa.cau9: You took the form of Sarasvatī, and by giving good understanding you saved the seers and sages.
m.chalisa.cau10: Ambā, you took the form of Narasiṃha and appeared, tearing the pillar apart.
m.chalisa.cau11: Protecting Prahlāda, you saved him, and you sent Hiraṇyakaśipu to heaven.
m.chalisa.cau12: You took the form of Lakṣmī in the world, and you dwell within the body of Śrī Nārāyaṇa.
m.chalisa.cau13: You take your delight in the Ocean of Milk. Ocean of mercy, fulfil the hope of my heart.
m.chalisa.cau14: Bhavānī, it is you at Hiṅgalāja; your boundless glory cannot be described.
m.chalisa.cau15: You are Mother Mātaṅgī and Dhūmāvatī, and Bhuvaneśvarī and Bagalā, the givers of joy.
m.chalisa.cau16: You are Śrī Bhairavī, and Tārā who carries the world across, and Chinnamastā of the severed head, who removes the sorrows of worldly existence.
m.chalisa.cau17: Bhavānī looks resplendent on her lion mount; the hero Lāṅgura goes before her.
m.chalisa.cau18: In your hands shine the skull-bowl and the sword; seeing them, Death flees in fear.
m.chalisa.cau19: Your weapons and trident gleam, and at them a pang rises in the enemy's heart.
m.chalisa.cau20: It is you who dwell at Nagarkoṭ; your drum resounds through the three worlds.
m.chalisa.cau21: You slew the demons Śumbha and Niśumbha, and destroyed Raktabīja and Śaṅkhāsura and his like.
m.chalisa.cau22: Mahiṣāsura, the king, was exceedingly proud; under the weight of his sins the earth was in torment.
m.chalisa.cau23: You took the dreadful form of Kālikā and destroyed him along with his army.
m.chalisa.cau24: Whenever hardship fell on the saints, Mother, each time you came to their help.
m.chalisa.cau25: The city of the immortals and the world of Indra remained free of sorrow through your glory.
m.chalisa.cau26: Your light is in the flame at Jvālā; men and women worship you always.
m.chalisa.cau27: When someone sings your glory with love and devotion, sorrow and poverty do not come near him.
m.chalisa.cau28: The one who meditates on you with his mind intent is released from birth and death.
m.chalisa.cau29: Yogīs, gods and sages proclaim aloud: Without your power there is no yoga.
m.chalisa.cau30: Śaṅkarācārya practised austerities and conquered desire and anger, every one.
m.chalisa.cau31: Night and day he meditated on Śiva; at no time did he remember you.
m.chalisa.cau32: He did not grasp the secret of your form as Śakti; when his power left him, he repented in his heart.
m.chalisa.cau33: He came to your refuge and told of your glory: Victory, victory, victory to you, Bhavānī, Mother of the world.
m.chalisa.cau34: The primal Mother of the world was pleased; she gave him power and made no delay.
m.chalisa.cau35: Mother, great distress has closed in on me; who but you can take away my sorrow?
m.chalisa.cau36: Hope and craving torment me terribly; a foolish enemy frightens me greatly.
m.chalisa.cau37: Destroy the enemy, great queen; with a single mind I remember you, Bhavānī.
m.chalisa.cau38: Be gracious, merciful Mother; grant me prosperity and attainment and make me content.
m.chalisa.cau39: As long as I live, may I receive the fruit of your mercy, and may I always tell of your glory.
m.chalisa.cau40: Those who sing the Durgā Chālīsā enjoy every happiness and attain the supreme state.
m.chalisa.cau41: Knowing Devīdāsa to be in your refuge, be gracious, Bhavānī, Mother of the world.
m.chalisa.do1: You protect those who come to you for refuge, and your devotee lives free from fear. I have come to your refuge, Mother: take me into your lap.
